title: Python debugging help
content: Why is my for loop skipping the last element?

title: Python debugging help
content: The issue is likely an off-by-one error. When you use range(len(arr)-1), the last index is excluded. Use range(len(arr)) instead to include all elements.

title: Learning Italian phrases
content: How do I say 'thank you very much' in Italian?

title: Learning Italian phrases
content: You say 'grazie mille' — literally 'a thousand thanks'. It's the most common way to express deep gratitude in Italian.

title: Learning Italian phrases
content: And how do I respond when someone says grazie to me?

title: Learning Italian phrases
content: You can say 'prego' (you're welcome), 'di niente' (it's nothing), or 'figurati' (don't mention it, informal).
